title: Wynncraft 3D Item Boxes
description: Reverts unidentified item boxes to 3D from before the Fruma Expansion (Version 2.2.0)
body:
Reverts unidentified item boxes to 3D from before the Fruma Expansion (Version 2.2.0)

This is **not** a texture replacement like the other resource pack, but this actually turns the item displayed in the GUI from a 2D item to a 3D item.

**Before (top) vs. After (bottom)**

![Before (top) vs. After (bottom)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c606ec98e7d94d8cb674d246dc338e8b856c1a74.png)

Requires a mod like Server Pack Unlocker to go over server resource packs.

Please let me know if there are any issues with the pack. My discord is ontheborderline
